_note: P1 step 1 farming (刘邦, SGODOT-239, q(59) §1.1 / §1.4). garden.plots: plot id → [col, row] on the garden grid, shared by the server (sprinkler coverage) and the client (P0Garden places plot [col, row] at PLOT_ORIGIN + 2 × [col, row]); 0–29 are P0's 6 × 5 and never move, 30–39 the two new columns on the right, row by row. How many of them the homestead has is 哪吒's homestead.plots (Lv1 30, Lv3 40; ids past 30 come as wild). facilities.kinds.sprinkler: stands on one empty plot, waters the ring of 8 around it on the grid (diagonals included, fewer at the edge), so a covered plot grows as it is sown; ripening there is cut by grow_cut, with Compost's 20% capped at grow_cut_cap together; how many may stand is homestead.sprinkler_max (3 + Homestead level, at most 10). workbench.recipes: the Sprinkler blueprint (to: field, built in place by the place command, never crafted; the Facilities tab comes from its tab, workbench belongs to 周瑜's line). farming.conveniences: the Farming level a convenience comes at (§4.6.1; harvest_all Lv9: harvest takes every ripe annual in the garden row underfoot at once, 0 Energy, q(118) ④; seed_saver Lv10: a harvest of a general annual — not regional, not perennial — gives back 1 seed of its kind with seed_saver_chance; title_master_gardener Lv10: the Master Gardener title, §4.6.1, no effect beyond its card — a title_* key here is a title the level brings, named by the client's P0Logic.TITLE_NAMES, SGODOT-275). goods.fert_orchard: Orchard Feed (§5.5), sold at the Market from Farming Lv7, 10 a day; on a tree that has been picked, halves its regrowth once (shop: market puts it on the Market's shelf). facilities.kinds.greenhouse (q(118) ②, §5.7): a glass roof over a 4×4 block of plots from its anchor (the block's lowest col and row); watered as sown, −25%, regional crops at their home time, no trees or sprinklers inside, 1 from Farming Lv8 and 2 from Lv10 (cap_by_farming); built at the workbench for 20 Timber, 12 Stone, 8 Copper Ore and 300 coins. grow_cut_cap 0.45: a greenhouse's 25% or a sprinkler's 15% with Compost's 20% (§5.7). facilities.kinds.compost_bin (q(118) ③, §5.7): stands on one yard cell (cover yard: the decor yard's rules, never a plot; default beside the workbench), one from Farming Lv7; turns up to `daily` (5) crops a player day — any crop, regional and fruit too — into Compost 1:1 in the bag (the compost command); built at the workbench for 6 Timber and 4 Stone.
